description: A company has decided to replace a vendor and now needs to track contract notice periods, data migration steps, parallel operations, documentation transfer, and the exact point at which the old service can be shut down.

user_profile.persona: 39-year-old systems manager overseeing a staged vendor exit
user_profile.context: The decision to switch is made; the hard part is carrying it out without dropping operational continuity
user_profile.communication_style: Sequencing-focused and risk-aware, wants a clear transition timeline

fact_sheet.fact: The contract termination notice for Legacy Data Corp was formally submitted by Innovatech's legal counsel, Maria Garcia, on May 15, 2024.
The contract with Legacy Data Corp (contract ID #LDC-8821) requires a 90-day notice period, making the official termination date August 13, 2024.
The new contract with Quantum Analytics Inc. (contract ID #QAI-5503) officially commenced on June 1, 2024, with an initial term of 36 months.
The final invoice from Legacy Data Corp, for the amount of $22,500, is due on September 1, 2024.
Project Nova, the vendor transition initiative, was officially kicked off on May 20, 2024, and is managed by systems manager Alex Chen.
The target completion date for the full migration of historical customer data to the Quantum Insight Platform is July 31, 2024.
The parallel operations phase, running both Legacy Data Hub and Quantum Insight Platform, will begin on July 1, 2024.
The official go-live date for the Quantum Insight Platform as the primary system of record is August 5, 2024.
The Legacy Data Hub service is scheduled for final shutdown on August 20, 2024, at 11:00 PM UTC.
Ben Carter is the Lead Data Engineer responsible for overseeing the data migration script execution for Project Nova.
A total of 7.2 terabytes of customer interaction data needs to be migrated from Legacy Data Hub's PostgreSQL database.
The data migration is being performed using a custom Python script that leverages the AWS Data Migration Service (DMS).
Data integrity will be validated by comparing MD5 checksums on 15% of the migrated records, specifically focusing on records from the last 24 months.
Legacy Data Corp must provide the final data export in a series of GZIP-compressed CSV files, delivered via SFTP to sftp.innovatech.com.
The parallel operations phase is scheduled to last for 35 days, from July 1, 2024, to August 5, 2024.
During parallel operations, the primary success metric is a less than 0.5% discrepancy in daily generated 'Active User' reports between the two platforms.
The marketing team will use the Quantum Insight Platform for all new campaign analytics starting July 15, 2024, while continuing to use Legacy Data Hub for historical reporting.
A final, read-only snapshot of the Legacy Data Hub database will be archived in Innovatech Solutions' AWS S3 Glacier Deep Archive bucket `innovatech-vendor-archive-2024` on August 19, 2024.
All API keys and user credentials for the Legacy Data Hub platform will be revoked by Alex Chen on August 20, 2024, at 11:30 PM UTC.
Legacy Data Corp is contractually obligated to provide a 'Certificate of Data Destruction' within 30 days of contract termination, by September 12, 2024.
All official project updates for Project Nova are posted in the Slack channel `#proj-nova-transition`.
A weekly transition status meeting is held every Tuesday at 10:00 AM PST via Google Meet link `meet.google.com/xyz-abcd-efg`.
The primary onboarding contact at Quantum Analytics Inc. is Sarah Jenkins, reachable at s.jenkins@quantumanalytics.io.
The login URL for the new Quantum Insight Platform is https://innovatech.quantumanalytics.io.
The login URL for the old Legacy Data Hub, for use during the parallel run, is https://innovatech.legacydatacorp.com.
The internal analytics dashboard must be updated to point from the old API endpoint `api.legacydatacorp.com/v2/reports` to the new endpoint `api.quantumanalytics.io/v1/data`.
All user guides and technical documentation from Legacy Data Corp have been transferred to the Confluence space 'LDC Archive' (key: LDCA).
Training materials and documentation for the Quantum Insight Platform are located in the Confluence space 'Quantum Platform' (key: QP).
A key identified risk (Risk ID #RN-004) is potential data corruption during the final delta migration scheduled for July 30, 2024.
The mitigation for risk #RN-004 is to perform a full database backup 1 hour prior to the delta migration and have a rollback script prepared by Ben Carter.

In addition to the data migration target date and go-live date, the major transition milestones are: the 90-day contract notice period ending with official termination on August 13, 2024; the parallel operations phase running from July 1, 2024, to August 5, 2024; and the transfer of old and new platform documentation into the Confluence spaces 'LDC Archive' and 'Quantum Platform' for transition reference.

For the remaining 85% of migrated records not covered by the MD5 checksum sample, validation will be performed through automated row-count reconciliation, schema-field completeness checks, and comparison of key aggregate business totals between Legacy Data Hub and the Quantum Insight Platform after each migration batch.
